timezone_policy: Store event-local dates/times and explicit timezone when known. All-day dates are authoritative calendar dates.
relevance_policy: Worldwide coverage is allowed, but geography never qualifies an event. direct events have explicit smart-glasses/XR/near-eye relevance; adjacent_watch events require a concrete optical, eyewear, component, manufacturing, accessibility, standards or deployment reason and must not imply that smart glasses will appear.

events.title: China International Optics Fair 2026
events.location: China International Exhibition Centre, Beijing, China
events.why_it_matters: The organizer explicitly identifies AI eyewear as a 2026 focus and schedules a smart-glasses and eyewear business-matching session, making CIOF a direct verification point for eyewear products, optical supply-chain relationships and acquisition leads.
events.organizer: China Optometric & Optical Association / Sinolight International Holdings Corporation

events.title: China International Optoelectronic Exposition 2026
events.location: Shenzhen World Exhibition & Convention Center, Shenzhen, China
events.why_it_matters: CIOE spans precision optics, displays, sensing and AR/VR, with dedicated optics/camera and AR/VR exhibition areas; it is a high-value verification point for near-eye display components, optical modules, manufacturing relationships and smart-glasses ecosystem changes.

events.title: AR VR Connect 2026
events.why_it_matters: European XR event relevant to near-eye display, AR and smart-glasses ecosystem tracking.

events.title: Meta Connect 2026
events.why_it_matters: Meta says the event will cover AI glasses, wearables, VR and developer sessions; it is a high-value source event for hardware, software and platform changes.

events.title: Moscow International Optical Fair (MIOF) — Autumn 2026
events.why_it_matters: MIOF is a major Russian eyewear and optical-industry gathering spanning frames, lenses, optometric equipment and optical-business infrastructure. It is worth monitoring for regional eyewear manufacturers, distributors, optical technologies and acquisition or supply-chain leads, but inclusion does not imply that smart glasses will be shown.

events.title: SILMO Paris 2026 — SILMO Next / Tech Village
events.why_it_matters: SILMO Next explicitly includes smart glasses, artificial intelligence and emerging eyewear technologies in its Tech Village and conference program, making the event directly relevant to product, optical-industry and adoption research.

events.title: ISMAR 2026
events.why_it_matters: Academic mixed- and augmented-reality research can expose display, tracking, interaction and human-factors work before it reaches products.

events.title: Augmented Enterprise Summit 2026
events.why_it_matters: Enterprise wearable deployments are a useful source for durability, workflow, support and real-world smart-glasses adoption evidence.

events.title: UnitedXR Europe 2026
events.why_it_matters: Broad XR industry event with potential smart-glasses launches, demonstrations and ecosystem updates.
